title: sneed-and-feed/lean-theorems-1
summary: A complete, machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of the Sylvester–Gallai theorem (J. J. Sylvester 1893, T. Gallai 1944, L. M. Kelly 1948; Freek Wiedijk #98). Proves that every finite non-collinear set of points in the real Euclidean plane contains an ordinary line passing through exactly two points of the set, formalized via Kelly's minimal point-line distance argument. To the maintainers' knowledge, the theorem was not found in an exact declaration name, docstring, and type signature search of the pinned Mathlib revision (Mathlib v4.34.0-rc1).

review.reason: Machine-checked Lean formalization of the Sylvester–Gallai theorem via Kelly's argument.
